svg.text: Tests fail when the pairing is unusual
each test against the pairing ratio of its own weights
pairing ratio of the test's weights
the same data sets against the pairing ratio of the design (size weights)
Simulated null data: M = 20 groups, one group's annotation profile 1.5–4 times as far out as the others, on the largest, the smallest or a random group (7,200 data sets).
Dashed line: the nominal rate, 0.05. Bands: 95% intervals per bin of the ratio. Grey: the range in which describe() gives no warning. Exchangeable weights ∝ 1/√(τ² + σ²_w / n_m).
Colour: weighting (blue size, orange equal, green exchangeable). Line: test (solid PLS, dashed correlation, dotted Mantel).
